analysis.scoreReason: RSI 중립 안착 + MACD 개선 지속

· Position vs SMA100($154.75)/SMA200($143.65): Long-term trend strength assessment, above both indicators.
· 52-week Position (64.4%) + Historical significance of current price level: Approximately 15% below 52-week high.

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.3034→0.2143) + Diagnosis of improvement + Confirmation of uptrend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $163.42) + Bandwidth 15.79% interpretation: Sideways consolidation near the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($187.12) + Significance of breakout: Potential for further upside towards 52-week high.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.98x) + Assessment of movement conviction: Normal level.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend) + Specification of entry/wait conditions: Entry for buy based on RSI neutral consolidation and MACD improvement.
